== Notes ==
* This skill is useful with [[scythe]]s, as it can end the stances of and cause a critical hit on up to three adjacent foes. 
* Very useful to secondary warriors in general, as no [[attribute point]]s are needed to be invested and other melee attack skill users do not have much use for adrenaline (with the exception of some [[Dervish]] skills or [[List of PvE-only skills|PvE skill]]s such as [["Save Yourselves!"]] or [[Brawling Headbutt]]).
* Adrenaline loss won't occur if the attack is [[interrupt]]ed.

==Hero Usage==
*Heroes will use this as a generic damage skill and won't save it for removing stances.
